name: outline-sections
description: Injects comment-based section markers into the VS Code Outline view

outlineSections.regionStartRegex.markdownDescription: Additional regex to detect custom region start lines. See [README](https://github.com/mantasu/outline-sections#settings) for examples.

outlineSections.regionEndRegex.markdownDescription: Optional regex to detect custom region end lines. If empty, regions close on the next region/header/subheader start.

outlineSections.dividerRegex.markdownDescription: Additional regex for the rule of banners and dividers (the `----` right after the comment marker). Built-in rules are 4+ repeats of `-` `=` `*` `#` `~` `_` `.` `+` `<` `>` `/` `%` `;`. See [README](https://github.com/mantasu/outline-sections#settings) for examples.

enumDescriptions: Coloured bold titles; rules and comment markers stay as comments.
Classic, plus a tint over the section the cursor is in.
outlineSections.highlight.profile.markdownDescription: How detected sections are highlighted. Every profile is a [CSS file](https://github.com/mantasu/outline-sections/tree/main/profiles); `#outlineSections.highlight.css#` rules are added on top.

outlineSections.highlight.css.markdownDescription: CSS rules added on top of the profile. Classes name parts (`.label`, `.rule`, `.delimiter`, `.keyword`, `.scope`) and kinds (`.header`, `.subheader`, `.region`, `.endregion`), e.g. `.endregion .keyword { color: #c586c0 }`. Set `--color` on a kind to change its colour (used as `var(--color)`), and `all: unset` to clear a style. See [README](https://github.com/mantasu/outline-sections#highlighting).

colors.description: Colour of banner (3-line) section titles and their scrollbar ticks.
Colour of divider (1-line) section titles and their scrollbar ticks.
